questions.question: Confirm the invitation features and implementation constraints.
questions.answer: Mandatory stack: React 18 + Vite, Tailwind CSS, framer-motion, canvas-confetti, lucide-react, Cinzel and Plus Jakarta Sans. Build the actual sophisticated responsive invitation, not a marketing page. Royal envelope entry uses safely rendered ?to= guest personalization on both envelope and welcome banner, with a graceful default. The opening user gesture initiates local /bg-music.mp3 playback, handles playback rejection honestly, triggers golden confetti subject to reduced-motion preferences, and opens an accessible calendar reminder modal. A floating vinyl control supports play/pause and reflects actual audio state. src/utils/calendar.js must generate RFC5545 iCalendar with correct escaping, CRLF, UTF-8-safe line folding, stable event UID, DTSTAMP, explicit timezone-safe event start/end, and DISPLAY alarms one day and two hours before each event. Detect Apple devices including iPad desktop user agents with touch capability, using an encoded data URI and a temporary anchor download for Apple; others use an encoded Google Calendar web intent. Provide individual Reception Wednesday evening and Muhurtham Thursday morning actions, with truthful browser/calendar caveats: no promise of automatic prompts, imports, notifications, or preserved alarms. Hero uses full-bleed muted looping playsInline /hero-bg.mp4 if available, otherwise a working local fallback image, with reduced-motion handling. Include an accurate Asia/Kolkata event countdown with a sensible post-event state, a responsive three-photo reel of actual local WebP files, and directions to Sri Convention Hall, Bengaluru without inventing an unverified street address or map pin. Include Open Graph metadata referencing an actual local 1200x630 JPG; final absolute canonical and OG URLs require the eventual public domain. Use working local licensed or clearly labeled demo media, with image/audio provenance and no broken asset URLs; never fabricate supplied couple photos, a video, or an audio recording. Implement keyboard access, visible focus, modal focus trap and restoration, Escape and close control, screen-reader labels, contrast, reduced motion, and touch/mobile layouts without overflow. Configure netlify.toml with build command npm run build, publish dist, and SPA redirect /* to /index.html with status 200. No API, login, datastore, Azure resources, or paid hosting. Test calendar validity/alarms, Apple desktop-iPad detection, Google URL encoding, guest handling, audio controls, modal interaction, countdown, asset existence/dimensions, reduced motion, and desktop/mobile layouts using suitable focused unit/component and browser checks. Run tests and production build, then start an available-port local Vite server and report its actual URL during scaffold implementation. Document content configuration, media provenance, browser/calendar limitations, and remaining publication prerequisites. Do not commit or deploy. Obtain explicit plan approval before required scaffold-agent handoff.
questions.rationale: These features and acceptance criteria are explicitly requested; they are captured without adding cloud services.
questions.recommendedChoice: Luxury responsive invitation; personalized royal envelope and welcome; gesture-initiated audio and golden confetti; floating vinyl player; accessible opening reminder modal; per-event Apple ICS and Google Calendar actions; cinematic hero, countdown, three-photo reel, venue directions; local media and OG image; Netlify configuration; tests, build, and running development server. No backend, Azure, deployment, or commits.
